title: jitso init outside a git checkout sets up the user account only and says how to set up a project
source: intended: jitso init, one command for every adoption step (owner request 2026-11-23)
intent: INTENDED behavior. From a folder that is not a git checkout, init installs the user skill and prints a note that a project is set up by running init inside it. --project-only there is exit 3, because there is no project.

stdout: jitso init: skill for your user account
note: this folder is not inside a git checkout, so only your user account was set up; run jitso init inside a project to set it up too

stderr: is not inside a git checkout
